legend: A mega-scale project to convert laser light into usable energy for general purposes has begun in the almost infinite experiment area with laser-amplifying glass panes.

The experiment was conducted by placing a laser emitter in one room. After that, the N$$$N$$$ laser receivers were placed in room coordinates (xi,yi)$$$(x_i,y_i)$$$; each room has a glass pane on the vertical and horizontal side which is shared between adjacent rooms.
When the laser passes through each vertical glass pane, the laser intensity is increased by A$$$A$$$ units.
When the laser passes through each horizontal glass pane, the laser intensity is increased by B$$$B$$$ units.

Furthermore, the administrator of the project has provided 1 L-shaped reflector to change the trajectory of the laser from horizontal to vertical or vice versa. You want to run Q$$$Q$$$ simulation tests to provide the information on the minimum possible laser intensity given the starting point for the laser at coordinates (si,ti)$$$(s_i,t_i)$$$; your task is to come up with the resulting laser intensity.
input: The first line contains four integers N,Q,A,B$$$N,Q,A,B$$$ (0≤A,B≤109,1≤N,Q≤100000$$$0 \le A,B \le 10^9,1 \le N,Q \le 100\,000$$$) — number of laser receivers, simulations, amplification power of vertical and horizontal glass panes.

Next, N$$$N$$$ lines contain xi,yi,ci$$$x_i,y_i,c_i$$$ (0≤xi,yi≤109,0≤ci≤1018$$$0 \le x_i,y_i \le 10^9,0 \le c_i \le 10^{18}$$$) — laser receiver coordinates in the Cartesian plane and laser amplification power.
Next, Q$$$Q$$$ lines contain si,ti$$$s_i,t_i$$$ (0≤si,ti≤109$$$0 \le s_i,t_i \le 10^9$$$) — laser emitter starting coordinates in the Cartesian plane in each simulation.
output: Print Q$$$Q$$$ lines, each line contains a single integer — the minimum possible laser intensity for the simulation.
note: For the first simulation, the L-shaped reflector can be placed on coordinate (3,4); by activating the second receiver, the minimum final laser intensity is 1+2+0=3$$$1+2+0 = 3$$$.
For the second simulation, the L-shaped reflector is not used; by activating the second receiver, the minimum final laser intensity is 2+0=2$$$2+0 = 2$$$.
For the third simulation, the L-shaped reflector can be placed on coordinate (1,5); by activating the fifth receiver, the minimum final laser intensity is 2+1+1+1+2=7$$$2+1+1+1+2 = 7$$$.

legend.ai: 一个将激光转换为可供一般用途使用的能量的超大规模项目，已经在几乎无限大的实验区域中启动，该区域由能够增强激光的玻璃板构成。
实验通过在一个房间内放置一个激光发射器来进行。随后，将 N$$$N$$$ 个激光接收器放置在房间坐标 (xi,yi)$$$(x_i,y_i)$$$ 处；每个房间与相邻房间共用的垂直和水平边上都安装有玻璃板。
当激光穿过每块垂直玻璃板时，激光强度会增加 A$$$A$$$ 个单位。
当激光穿过每块水平玻璃板时，激光强度增加 B$$$B$$$ 个单位。
此外，项目管理员提供了 1 个 L 形反射器，用于将激光的轨迹从水平方向改变为竖直方向，或反之。你需要运行 Q$$$Q$$$ 次模拟测试，以提供给定激光起点坐标 (si,ti)$$$(s_i,t_i)$$$ 时激光强度的可能最小值；你的任务是计算最终的激光强度。

input.ai: 第一行包含四个整数 N、Q、A、B$$$N,Q,A,B$$$ (0≤A,B≤109,1≤N,Q≤100000$$$0 \le A,B \le 10^9,1 \le N,Q \le 100\,000$$$)，分别表示激光接收器的数量、模拟次数，以及竖直和水平玻璃板的放大功率。
接下来 N$$$N$$$ 行每行包含 xi,yi,ci$$$x_i,y_i,c_i$$$ (0≤xi,yi≤109,0≤ci≤1018$$$0 \le x_i,y_i \le 10^9,0 \le c_i \le 10^{18}$$$)，分别表示笛卡尔平面中激光接收器的坐标以及激光放大功率。
接下来 Q$$$Q$$$ 行每行包含 si,ti$$$s_i,t_i$$$ (0≤si,ti≤109$$$0 \le s_i,t_i \le 10^9$$$)，表示每次模拟中激光发射器在笛卡尔平面中的起始坐标。

output.ai: 输出 Q$$$Q$$$ 行，每行包含一个整数——模拟中激光强度的可能最小值。

note.ai: 在第一次模拟中，L 形反射器可以放置在坐标 (3,4) 处；激活第二个接收器后，最终激光强度的最小值为 1+2+0=3$$$1+2+0 = 3$$$。
在第二次模拟中，不使用 L 形反射器；激活第二个接收器后，最终激光强度的最小值为 2+0=2$$$2+0 = 2$$$。
在第三次模拟中，L 形反射器可以放置在坐标 (1,5) 处；激活第五个接收器后，最终激光强度的最小值为 2+1+1+1+2=7$$$2+1+1+1+2 = 7$$$。
